challenge.description: A supplier contract for the next promotion week is already signed, and the team cannot deploy the new model without a shadow run to verify it. #reliability_ruth# demands a fully automated and governed shadow environment to protect the live forecast, while #automation_alex# insists on keeping it manual to avoid breaking the current pipeline stability.

output.content: I am willing to accept the canary testing environment remaining done by hand for this cycle. My priority is ensuring the new shadow run for the locked supplier contract is fully automated and governed. If we prioritize the shadow infrastructure, I can live with manual canary steps temporarily. This trade off lets us verify the model without risking the live forecast pipeline. I will not compromise on the shadow environment being automated, as that is critical for the promotion week deployment. The manual canary work is a concession I am making to protect the core deployment stability we need right now.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to accept losing the automation of the canary testing environment in exchange for prioritizing the automation of the shadow run.
